notes.title: (actually) Huge Update
notes.content:
howdy!

I've finished up getting a decent amount of the basics down for the game.

This will be a small playtest, 1 with server to start and I can start up more if needed.  I don't think too many people will be on this playtest as it won't be blasted.

Each server can handle 14 players.  This can be adjusted as needed.  I'd rather have the server feel slightly empty instead of too crowded with people running around everywhere.

New Menu Map!

Map Updates:
[list]
[*] Map has been adjusted since the last playtest.
[*] Added Warehouse POI.
[*] New safezone in the mountains to the northwest.
[*] Random camps are placed throughout the map with more to be added later.
[/list]

Weapon updates:
[list]
[*] Added Honey Badger
[*] Old weapons are available: Kar98, M4A1, M1982, AK74M.
[*] Attachments are being added/fixed in the next build.
[/list]

Animation updates:
[list]
[*] Characters and weapons have new animations, some are a little buggy but will be fixed as I can get around to it.  I'm not very well versed in animating, so this is slightly lower priority.
[/list]

Character Customization
[list]
[*] Character customization is coming soon.  I'm working on trying to get Unreal Engine's MetaHumans working with the kit.  It should offer way more customization options on top of having modular vests, helmets, etc.  This is brand new technology so it's still a work in progress to get it integrated.
[/list]

Known Issues (more to be added):
[list]
[*] Some animations are glitchy for the character. These are being tweaked and fixed over time.
[*] If your weapon gets stuck in front of you in a weird way it's because you tried to sprint and jump too fast, doing this again should fix it.
[*] Vendor is missing items
[*] Some attachments may not attach to weapons.  This is high priority to fix.
[/list]


Please visit our [url=https://discord.gg/ADgGvRS6aW]Discord[/url] and post any fun screenshots, feedback, bugs, etc!  

Remember: I'm a solo developer.  I'm doing this all by myself so if I don't respond back fast or at all I promise I am not ignoring you, there's just a lot going on! (Not on the Discord, it's dead, but in the background, ya know).

notes.title: (Kinda) Huge Updates
notes.content:
* Added brushing sounds with bushes. When a player walks through a bush it you will hear it (hopefully not across the map)
* Added a long range scope, it bugs out when crouching or moving this is a known issue
* Added bullet shells/casings ejecting from the weapon
* Added a weapon laser for M4 and M416. This is experimental.
* Added binoculars.
* Fixed silencer position on M416.
* Silencer now reduces the regular gun sound instead of replacing the gun sound completely.
* Weapon fire toggle makes a sound that everyone can hear.
* Footstep sounds tweaked
* Added bullet decals for all surfaces (i think)
* Most surfaces have unique sounds and particle effects when bullets hit them now. This will be updated over time.
* New flashlight model (still need to update artwork)
* Grenades make a sound when they hit the floor now.
* Many map changes.
* New mountaintop warehouse area is a WIP and there's no loot there.

notes.content:
[list]
[*] this patch should fix m4. if the reload is still broken you may have to drop that weapon or sell it to a vendor and buy another one.

notes.title: Cooldown and Small Wipe
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added cooldowns to items.  Because of this there was a character inventory/equipment wipe but you still retain your XP and money in the bank.
[*] Removed bugged rocks.
[*] Added XP to character equipment panel using the middle tab. The quick view XP in the bottom left will be restored soon and will be able to be hidden along with the rest of the HUD.
[*] Cooldown info will be shown on items soon.
[*] Meds take 5 seconds between uses.
[*] Bandages take 3 seconds.
[*] Food takes 5 seconds.
[*] Drinking is faster but still has a cooldown longer than 1 second.
[*] Meds now have use sounds that everyone can hear.
[/list]
